name: FileUpload
description: File picker with size validation and clear control.

dense: single-file picker: readonly summary + Browse/Clear over a hidden input; accept filter, maxSizeInBytes rejection (localized), default/editorial looks; onFileChange(File | null)

usage.description: FileUpload is the single-file picker: a readonly summary field showing "name (size)" plus Browse and Clear buttons driving a hidden native input. It enforces maxSizeInBytes client-side (rejects, clears, and shows a localized error) and filters the picker via accept. Two appearances: default (TextInput + Button) and editorial (Combobox-style field for editorial forms).

bestPractices.description: Always set accept and maxSizeInBytes; a picker without limits fails at the server instead of at the field.
Pass clearButtonLabel so users can undo a wrong pick without re-opening the OS dialog.
State the accepted formats and size cap in helperText; the accept filter is invisible until the dialog opens.
Treat onFileChange(null) as "cleared": reset your form state and any pending upload.
Do not use value to represent an already-uploaded server file; it only mirrors a local File object.
Do not rely on the size check as security; it is UX-only and must be re-validated server-side.
Do not use it for multi-file needs; it holds exactly one file (last pick wins).

anatomy.name: Hidden input
anatomy.description: The native type=file input (aria-hidden, tabindex -1) that actually opens the OS picker and holds accept.

anatomy.name: Summary field
anatomy.description: Readonly TextInput (default) or Combobox-style trigger (editorial) showing "name (size)" or the placeholder; clicking opens the picker.

anatomy.name: Browse button
anatomy.description: Secondary @dt/Button (or editorial text button) labelled by uploadButtonLabel.

anatomy.name: Clear button
anatomy.description: Appears once a file is chosen and clearButtonLabel is set; resets the input and emits onFileChange(null).

anatomy.name: HelperText
anatomy.description: Helper or error line; size-rejection errors replace helper text until the next pick.
